summary: Large riverside bushland car park; nearest home 58 m, many cars parked.
reasons: Backs onto bush and the Brisbane River
Nearest dwelling 58 m; other buildings non-residential
Big car park, a van blends in

drivers.seclusion: Bush and river on the west and north; nearest dwelling 58 m and sheds 24 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed entry off the roundabout road; wide bays with room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet campus road at the south end; no through traffic in the car park.
drivers.convention: Many cars park here; signs mix P (No Limit) with 2P angle, so check the bay's sign.

flags: Mixed signs: 2P angle, P no limit, no parking and no stopping nearby
Steep at the river end: up to 23% on the outline, flat on the east bays
Low-lying at the west end (5.5 m), 12 m on the east bays; river 149 m away
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades much of the car park; mostly afternoon shade from the western bush.
cannot_judge: Which sign covers the chosen bays

best_section.where: Eastern bays of the car park off Sir William MacGregor Drive, beside the bush strip
